name: Stress test a business plan before you commit money
why: Tests a plan's weak assumptions before money is committed, alongside the business-plan-send-ready-check prompt.

name: Size a market and separate the facts from the guesses
why: Builds a sourced market section and keeps estimates labelled, the way the business plan skill requires.

name: Forecast your startup runway and prepare a finance pack
why: A runway forecast and finance pack to attach to a lender or grant application.

name: Bad-year break-even tester
why: Shows how much a bad year can take before the business stops earning, a sharper version of the break-even test cases.

name: Lean-year cash rules writer
why: Writes the buffer size and red lines for thin months, to sit beside the 13-week forecast.

name: Tax set-aside planner
why: Turns the share your accountant gives into a set-aside rule and dates, the tax account in the allocation set-up.

name: Weekly invoice and cash chaser
why: Weekly check of open invoices with reminders you approve, the collect-sooner fix from the forecast.

name: Get a late invoice paid and keep the customer
why: A firm but friendly path for one late payer, matching the reminder sequence in the client process prompt.

name: Hourly rate calculator
why: Quick hourly, day and project rates from target pay, costs and billable hours, the first step of the freelance rate skill.

name: Client fee and cap setter
why: Sets a fee and a client limit from an income floor, useful when packaging retainer work.

name: Quarterly client rate reviewer
why: Finds each client's real hourly rate every quarter and who to raise, the follow-up to the rate worksheet.

name: Prepare your first freelance project quote
why: Turns a brief into a scoped quote with contract risks to check before sending; sending it as binding needs your yes.

name: Invoice maker
why: Lays out a clear, checked invoice for the last step of the client process.

name: Monthly freelancer books closer
why: Monthly close for freelancers with a tax set-aside and a 90-day cash view, feeding the allocation routine.

name: Prepare a grant spending evidence pack
why: After a grant is awarded, gathers the spending evidence funders ask for, the last step of the loan-or-grant workflow.
